# DECOBAY Interiors

> California Architectural & Interior Design Firm creating minimalist, warm and timeless residential and commercial interiors.

DECOBAY Interiors (DECOBAY Designs LLC) designs full homes, single rooms and commercial spaces across California. Free 30-minute consultations are booked online.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Studio overview, philosophy, selected projects, services and free consultation booking.
- [Sarita residence](/sarita): Featured California project with photo gallery and interactive 3D walkthrough.
